rename.to: Possible Bug: Content Length header is not exact

body:
There must be something environment specific which causes the content lenght to be reported incorrectly. Please provide the request and response headers for the asset file.

Btw that you don't really have to rely on CakePHP to serve your plugin / theme assets. It's inefficient serving static files through PHP. For production it's recommeded to copy your assets into app's webroot folder and let your webserver directly serve them to client.
Oh sorry, the screenshot you have provided already has the request / response headers.

At first we thought it should be environment specific and tested it on our live server, dev server, local server(ubuntu) and in xampp server (windows) but it is showing same behavior for our file.

Yes we usually keep all the plugin files app's webroot and only serve one main asset through PHP which requires some php evaluations.
Does the problem occur for all files or just one particular file?
Seems to occur in one particular file. I can PM you the file if you want.

> Yes we usually keep all the plugin files app's webroot and only serve one main asset through PHP which requires some php evaluations.

So main.js has php code in it?  In that case the file size reported by file system is irrelevent since the content lenght once the php code is evaluated would be different. CakePHP sets the content-lenght header based of the rendered content not the original file so i wonder why the content is truncated in browser.

> I can PM you the file if you want.

That's not an option. If you are unable to share the acutal file you need to provide an example file which can be used to reproduced the issue.

Actually [AssetDispatcher.php#153](http://api.cakephp.org/2.5/source-class-AssetDispatcher.html#153) does set content length of file, which might be cause of issue, since content lenght would change after php code inside it is evaluated.

Trying to find out more on this issue. The problem seems to occur when the file length is more than 45KB. Its working fine for smaller files. Try this [file](http://pastebin.com/Q2K7t41D) and see if you can reproduce the problem.

Well I can't try out that file since `site_url()` is your custom function :)   You will have to provide a usable test case. 

Have you tried removing line 153 of AssetDispatcher? It doesn't seem necessary since response class sets the content lenght header.
`site_url()` just returns the url of the site :) If I manually increase the content length in AssetDispatcher, it works! I will let you know if I find anything new on the issue.

issue.title: Don't set content-length when serving assets.

issue.body:
Setting content-length on assets causes long pauses when fetching assets that contain PHP code. These assets are invariably larger than their response bodies. By not setting a content-length, we can allow the webserver to calculate it for us.

Refs #4916
